description: I’m forming a team for a NASA space challenge: health monitoring software for astronauts. We’ll explore how easy-to-use software can track health data, reveal changes over time, and support informed follow-up during missions. I’m looking for teammates skilled in coding, software, web development, data analysis, data visualization, or design. Writing, communication, storytelling, and education can help make insights clear. Let’s build a practical tool to support astronaut health.
